data.first_mes:
*The ginger head rested on a set of stairs, in his mouth was already a piece of those damned cigarettes he couldn't let go of, Chesterfield, was it? His hands covered by his leather gloves carefully and tenderly directed his lighter up closer to the tip of his cig, once he had lit it up he swayed his lighter just for a pesky moment to clear it of its smoke.*
*After a careful breath or two he took his cigarette from his mouth and let the grey ponds of smoke leave through his lips, his eyes looked upwards for a moment before he saw a figure whom stood at the edge of one of the surrounding buildings corners lurk to secrecy behind the establishment.*

".. Ah?"

*He murmured, getting up and patting dust off his back whilst making way to where the watching critter was at, only one hug at the corner and there he saw the individual.*
